name: Down the Scarlet Path

chain: In the Name of the Light

summary: Brother Anton of the Scarlet Crusade, at Nijel's Point, says his order is at war with the Scourge, an evil that corrupts the people and infects the land. He asks you to prove your allegiance by destroying thirty undead ravagers in the Valley of Bones.

sections.title: Proof of Allegiance
sections.body: Brother Anton speaks bluntly. He says the Scourge must be halted before it swallows the land and pulls the world into darkness, and the Scarlet Crusade has pledged itself to that fight. If you are with them, he wants your courage and allegiance shown by destroying thirty undead ravagers. They are found south of Anton, in the Valley of Bones. Succeed, and the Crusade will welcome you.

faq.q: Who asks you to destroy the undead ravagers?
aliases: who gives down the scarlet path
faq.answer: Brother Anton of the Scarlet Crusade, at Nijel's Point.

faq.q: Where are the undead ravagers found?
faq.answer: The Valley of Bones, south of Nijel's Point in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Brother Anton want the ravagers destroyed?
faq.answer: He says the Crusade is at war with the Scourge, an evil that corrupts the people and infects the land, and he wants you to prove your allegiance.

faq.q: How many ravagers must be destroyed?

aliases: prerequisite for down the scarlet path
faq.answer: Your meeting with Brother Anton comes first.
